details: Sender: Rohit Sharma, Flat 4B, Green Heights, Indiranagar, Bengaluru. Recipient: Mr. S. Gowda (landlord), 12 5th Cross, HSR Layout, Bengaluru.
story: I rented a 2BHK in HSR Layout, Bengaluru from Mr Gowda from 1 June 2023 to 31 May 2025. Rent was Rs 30,000 and I paid a security deposit of Rs 90,000 by bank transfer. I vacated on 31 May 2025 and handed over keys, he did a walkthrough and said all ok. Agreement said deposit will be refunded in 30 days. It's now 4 months, he keeps saying 'next week'. Yesterday he said he will deduct Rs 40,000 for painting and 'damage' but never showed any bill. I have the registered rent agreement, bank transfer proof, WhatsApp chats and photos from move-out day.
negotiation_turns: Mr Gowda, I vacated 4 months ago. Please return my Rs 90,000 deposit.
You never showed any bill for painting. Normal wear and tear cannot be deducted. Show me the invoice.
I will send a legal notice if the full amount is not returned in 15 days.

details: Complainant: Priya Verma, Lucknow, UP. Opposite party: ShopKart Pvt Ltd (e-commerce platform), grievance officer email on website.
story: Maine 2 September ko ShopKart app se ek phone order kiya, Rs 24,999 ka, UPI se pay kiya. Phone ka screen damaged aaya. Maine 5 September ko return request daal diya, pickup 9 September ko ho gaya. Ab 2 mahine ho gaye refund nahi aaya. Customer care har baar bolta hai '7 working days me ho jayega'. 3 baar complaint ticket banaya hai. Mere paas order confirmation, UPI payment screenshot, damaged phone ki photos aur video, return pickup message aur ticket numbers hain.
negotiation_turns: Mera refund 2 mahine se pending hai, Rs 24,999 abhi chahiye.
Aapne pickup confirm kiya tha, ab warehouse ka bahana kyu?
Agar 7 din me refund nahi aaya to main consumer commission me complaint karungi.

details: Sender: Anil Kumar, Pune. Recipient: Director, BrightEdge Marketing Pvt Ltd, Baner, Pune.
story: I worked as a graphic designer at BrightEdge Marketing in Pune since January 2024. Salary Rs 35,000/month. They haven't paid my July and August 2025 salary, total Rs 70,000. Boss says client payments are stuck. I got an offer letter on email, salary slips till June, and WhatsApp messages from my boss admitting the delay. I resigned on 1 September with 30 days notice and my last day was 30 September. They are also now saying I must pay notice-period recovery of Rs 35,000 though I served the notice. No experience letter given either.
negotiation_turns: Sir, I need my July and August salary of Rs 70,000 this week.
I served my full notice period, so there is no recovery. Please also give my experience letter.
If not paid, I will approach the Labour Commissioner.
